Company that bought YouTube in 2006 and folded it into Alphabet.

How Google connects

  • Topic: YouTube — Google acquired YouTube in 2006 and has owned the platform since.
  • Item: Google AdSense — Google built AdSense and then wired it to YouTube inventory.
  • Creator: Susan Wojcicki — Wojcicki was a longtime Google executive before and during her YouTube years.

What is Google?

Google acquired YouTube for $1.65 billion in stock in 2006, keeping the brand while wiring AdSense, search, and later YouTube Premium into the parent company.

Key threads lead to YouTube, Google AdSense and Susan Wojcicki.
